[[File:Spawn maturing.gif|frame|left|A spawn maturing into a scion.]]

'''Scions''' are matured [[spawn]]s during the fight with the [[Abyssal Sire]]. The spawn matures into a scion if it is not killed within 12 seconds. Scions boast more health, accuracy, and damage.

Like the Abyssal Sire, scions can hit through protection prayers. Similarly to [[snakeling]]s, scions will automatically die when the Sire is killed, or if they are unable to attack the player for more than 30 seconds.

Despite visually resembling [[abyssal demon]]s they do not count towards [[Slayer task]] completion or Slayer log score for Abyssal Demons.
